title: the-proveme-door-refuses-a-proof-name-that-resolves-to-no-file
intention: The forward crossing into PROVEME refuses when any proof it would carry to PROVED — named on this crossing or on one since the latest forward BUILDME — resolves to no file, so a dead proven_by is caught at the crossing where naming the right path is still free instead of at the hollow or at PROVED.
why: Measured 2026-10-07 on 41202d4c8d3b (8y): its PROVEME crossing (skills/sail/history.json, 19:53:47) named proven_by 'test_sail_sweeps_the_tree_first.py', a bare name resolving to no file, and the proof-named seat recorded 'clean — proof named'. The hollow then refused ('none of the proofs [...] declares a PROVES entry'), and the only repair was a kick-back to TICKETME, because proven_by_since_buildme cuts only at a forward BUILDME and clearance's [proof_on_disk] would red the dead name at PROVED. Peer F19 (2026-10-08): 'Finding 1: YES, ticket it. The PROVEME door refuses a proven_by that resolves to no file, which is the same vacuous shape as F16.'
traces_to: Law 8 (nothing enters proven-space without a proof a hollow build couldn't pass — a name that points at nothing is a vacuous pass of the seat, the same shape F16 refused) and Law 7 (errors are loud at the diagnostic surface: the seat said 'clean — proof named' over a name that named nothing).
how: Extend the proof-named seat in cairn/tools/base/transitions.py (inspect_proof_named, ticket 7203db7f151e) with a second lane: each name in the union is resolved the way proof_coverage.lacks resolves it at PROVED (absolute as is, else the cairn repo root / name) and must be a file; ProofNamedRed carries the dead names and where each came from. New proof in cairn/tools/base/proofs.
falsifier: Falsifier: a new proof cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_a_dead_proof_name_is_refused_at_proveme.py, green and sealed under bin/cairn test --netns, teeth under PROVES for this ticket: (1) test_a_bare_name_that_resolves_to_no_file_is_refused — a fixture PROVEME crossing with proven_by = this proof's bare filename (it exists in proofs/, not at the repo root: the 8y shape exactly) raises ProofNamedRed naming the name, the lane finding has expected != actual and values.dead == [{name, from: 'this crossing'}], and no history or state is written; (2) test_a_real_path_crosses_and_a_mixed_list_names_only_the_dead — the repo-relative path of this proof crosses with the lane reading clean and values.dead == []; its absolute path crosses too; a list [real path, 'p/gone.py'] is refused naming only 'p/gone.py'; (3) test_a_dead_name_since_buildme_is_refused — with crossings.ROOTS pointed at a fixture world whose history.json holds a forward BUILDME crossing for the fixture ticket carrying proven_by 'p/gone.py', a PROVEME crossing naming a real proof is refused naming 'p/gone.py' from 'since BUILDME'. test_proveme_names_its_proof.py, test_transitions.py and harbor_master's test_clearance.py stay green unchanged. Hollow: teeth 1-3 red with transitions.py reverted to the pre-build commit (each depends on a refusal the old seat never makes). Horizon: this voyage; then every ticketed PROVEME record carries values.dead.
